summary: Ubuntu 6.10 (Edgy Eft) was released on 26 October 2006. It introduced the Upstart init daemon (replacing SysV init), a new Human theme, automated crash reports (Apport), Tomboy note-taking app, and F-Spot photo manager. EasyUbuntu was included as a meta-package.
notes: Unsupported since 2008-04-25. Kernel 2.6.17. 'Eft' is a young newt; 'Edgy' signaled a release at the cutting edge.
